Card Q&A.q: My opponent has no Digimon. I activated this card's [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] effect, but none of my opponent's Digimon were deleted. At such times, is the "if this effect didn't delete" condition met?

My opponent only has 1 Digimon, and it has an effect that prevents deletion. I activated this card's [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] effect, but none of my opponent's Digimon were deleted. At such times, is the "if this effect didn't delete" condition met?

Card Q&A.a: No, it isn't met. The "if this effect didn't delete" condition is only met when no Digimon are deleted by this effect. If even 1 Digimon is deleted, this condition isn't met.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has 1 Digimon with 6000 DP and an effect that prevents deletion, and they have 1 Digimon with 6000 DP and no effects. Is the "if this effect didn't delete" condition met if I activate this card's [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] effect and delete their Digimon other than the Digimon with an effect that prevents deletion?
Do [On Play] effects trigger for Digimon played into the breeding area by this card's [When Attacking] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] Delete all of your opponent's lowest DP Digimon. If this effect didn't delete, trash their deck's top 5 cards.
[When Attacking] If your opponent has 10 or more cards in their trash, you may play 1 red or purple 5000 DP or lower Digimon card from your trash to your empty breeding area without paying the cost.
[End of Your Turn] This Digimon may attack.
